confidence_notes: FX is from the RBA search result for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). I ran one food search for Kenting. It gave NT$ ranges from travel blogs of uncertain date: meals of NT$150-400, beer of NT$100-150 and coffee of NT$60-120. I ran no searches for cocktails or wine. Those two are estimated from the beer price, with cocktails at about 2.5x beer and wine at about 2.5x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not inspected listings. Kenting is a seasonal beach resort, so July peak-season hotel prices are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Taiwan resort-town pricing, using Hengchun and Kenting Street as the reference. Prices are somewhat above Taiwan's typical regional-city level and well below Taipei hotel levels in the off-season.
